notes.title: v1.0.2 - Update
notes.notes:
Another update is here. Thank you everyone for the feedback and bug reports!

If you want to show your support to the game and ShotX, don't forget that one of the best ways to do so can be simply done by leaving a review.

v1.0.2
[list]
[*] Added mouse lock option
[*] Fixed player getting stuck in walls
[*] Fixed ending generation bug
[*] Added new ending elements
[*] Enemy AI updates
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
